title: The personal website for Andrew Marritt
text:
Welcome. I’m an analyst, coach and teacher. One of the pioneers in the discipline of People Analytics I’m passionate about helping those new to the discipline learn how to create impact through their work.
An economist by training, I work to combine a deep, research-based, multi-disciplinary understanding of the world of work with a wide-range of innovative analytic approaches. For 10 years I pioneered the use of Machine Learning approaches, especially text analysis, to understand employee data.
These days I act as an analytics consultant, an educator and a writer.

About me Background information including an archive of my public speaking
My writing I write a popular, research-based Substack on the world of work
Courses & books Information on the courses that I’m currently teaching. I’m increasingly adapting my research into books, many of which will be openly available here.

title: About
text:
Over the last 15 years I’ve been invited to speak on many occasions on innovative uses of analytics approaches to better understand employees and the world of work. On this page you can find some of the media coverage that I’ve had and the public presentations that I’ve given.
For a broader overview of my background see my LinkedIn profile

title: Courses and Books
text:
I currently teach the following courses. I adapt each of these courses to use domain-specific datasets. My current teaching is at a hospitality school so all are currently available with real hospitality data. All are aimed at Masters and MBA students but can be adapted.

Data Visualisation Currently a 40 hour course split 50/50 between theory and practice. Most practical work uses the Grammar of Graphics approaches in R
Data Science Another 40 hour course split 50/50 between theory and practice. Practical work is in R
Introduction to statistics This comprises of 20 hours Bayesian Statistics and 20 hours Frequentist and Bootstrap approaches
Decision Science In development for later in 2026. A wide-ranging course on decision science which uniquely combines 6 different schools of thought to provide a broad overview of the subject
Modern marketing for Hospitality - I teach modern approaches to marketing to 3 levels of hospitality students

Quote: “CHROs have said that they feel [pressured] as the only ones not bringing data to the table. The business is expecting HR to have similar numbers to marketing, though maybe not finance or operations,” observed Andrew Marritt, CEO of OrganizationView, a people analytics practice based in St Moritz, Switzerland.
